extracted.name: Blueberry or Cherry Cheesecake Dessert
extracted.description: If you have to feed a crowd, and they happen to love cheesecake, then this is the recipe for you. It bakes up in a large 9x13-inch pan and is easy to make. Cherry pie filling may be substituted for blueberry, or use both!
ingredient_lines: 1 (16 ounce) package frozen whipped topping, thawed
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees F (165 degrees C). Melt butter in a medium bowl. Stir in 1 cup sugar and graham cracker crumbs until well combined. Press evenly into the bottom of a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Beat eggs in a large bowl. Beat in cream cheese, the remaining 1 cup sugar, and vanilla until smooth. Spread the mixture evenly over the crust.
Bake until the filling is just set in the center, 15 to 20 minutes. Cool completely.
Spread blueberry or cherry pie filling evenly over the cooled cheesecake layer. Spread whipped topping over the pie filling. Refrigerate until thoroughly chilled before serving.
